reviewedAssets.observation: low-complexity line/polygon topology is substantially retained and the question-mark panel is left empty
standalone polygon options are retained; printed option labels are not yet promoted to textGlyph
simple closed polygons and relative placement are retained
circles and curved interiors are lost, so this asset does not belong in the simple closed-polygon renderer
curved matrix cells are approximated by dense short line segments
solid triangular regions are not preserved and Hough line artifacts dominate
large filled regions become dense line fans instead of face primitives
triangular lattice and shading semantics are not retained consistently

conclusion: The first pass proves a useful simple-polygon subset but does not validate the whole subtype. No asset is final-accepted in this review.
